evidence: Modifies `src/streams.h` to redesign `BufferedWriter` error handling, preventing exceptions from escaping during destruction.
rationale: Fixes an abrupt `std::terminate` crash in `BufferedWriter` by removing implicit throwing flushes from destructors and providing safe `flush()` and `discard()` methods. Author notes this regression was introduced in #31551, causing crashes when disk writes fail rather than graceful unwinding.
